I want a balanced offensive/defensive team that can handle common threats. I'll pick a core of strong Gen 9 and older mons: Incineroar (fake out/intimidate support), Dragapult (fast attacker), Gholdengo (good typing/sticky web immunity), Toxapex (wall), Palafin (strong physical attacker), and Archaludon (special wall/attacker with stamina). Actually let me pick a cohesive 6: Incineroar, Dragapult, Gholdengo, Toxapex, Palafin, Archaludon. These cover various roles and are all legal.

Archaludon: Stamina, Flash Cannon, Dragon Pulse, Stealth Rock, Protect. EVs: 32 HP / 32 Def, Relaxed? Actually use 32 SpD / 32 Def. Metal Coat.
